description.en: Moshes plants back a space when his jam is playing. Releases skunks to protect himself.
description.zh: 舞蹈时，将植物向左侧空间踢走。释放臭鼬保护自身。

chat.en: Skunk Punk shared his hairspray and hair dye with his pets, masking their original stench.
chat.zh: 臭鼬朋克将自己的发胶和染发剂分享给这些动物朋友们，掩盖了它们原有的气味。

text.en: skunks rush forwards when his jam is playing
text.zh: 舞蹈时，臭鼬将失控向前冲

text.en: Magnet Shrooms pull off his head
